c1_realised_variance.estimator: RV_t = sum_i r_{t,i}^2 with r = ln(P_i / P_{i-1})
c1_realised_variance.selection_rule: Reject any frequency whose noise share exceeds 0.10 or whose relative standard error exceeds 0.25, then take the finest survivor. Declared before evaluation; no downstream metric participates.

c2_price_impact.dependent_variable: bar log return, ln(P_i / P_{i-1}), within session only
c2_price_impact.fitting_procedure: ordinary least squares, HC1 heteroskedasticity-robust SE
c2_price_impact.signing_caveat: Trade direction is not published by NSE. Signs are inferred by the tick test, which misclassifies some bars and attenuates lambda toward zero. These coefficients are therefore conservative, and are not an exchange statement about order flow.

c5_arrival.resolution: daily counts; NSE publishes no trade timestamps in any dataset obtained here, so inter-arrival times are not observable
c5_arrival.estimator: Poisson MLE lambda = mean daily count; negative binomial by method of moments Var = mu + mu^2/k
c5_arrival.dispersion_test: chi-squared (n-1)*Var/Mean against the Poisson null, one-sided at alpha=0.05

c3_amihud.formula: mean over the window of |r_t| / turnover_t

c3_cross_check.interpretation: The two rankings agree (rho=0.289, p=0.04178, n=50): securities the daily Amihud proxy calls illiquid are the ones the intraday regression finds have the largest price impact.

false_alarm_budget.rationale: Alarms are read by a person. At ~250 sessions a year, alpha=0.01 is two to three alarms per instrument per year: rare enough to be worth opening, frequent enough not to miss a regime change for years. Chosen from review capacity, not from the resulting detection rate.

c6_liquidity_state.attribution_rule: contribution_j = z_j / sum over components with z_k > 0. Computed from the state vector's own z-scores; no hardcoded explanation.

amihud_vs_price_impact.interpretation: The two rankings agree (rho=0.289, p=0.04178, n=50): securities the daily Amihud proxy calls illiquid are the ones the intraday regression finds have the largest price impact.

detector.dependency: research.market.arrival -> data/reference/week2_overdispersion.json -> this detector. Constructing without the Week 2 result raises MissingWeek2Input; there is no Poisson fallback.

week8_integration.interpretation: The Poisson band would have called 72642 of 151648 scored sessions an event. Widening it by the Week 2 dispersion factor of 205.7 leaves 2081. The difference is the Week 2 result doing work.
